topic: GitHub calls the live guard can only mark opaque
detail: SP-043 marks these opaque, so block-other-jobs allows them (opaque_unverified) and only strict refuses: a git remote behind an ssh alias whose host name does not say GitHub (the usual per-account setup, e.g. Host work-gh), a checkout config with url.*.insteadOf or an include (the user's global git config is not read at all), gh api graphql, gh aliases and extensions, and gh search beyond the accounts it names. Proposed: read the ssh client config's Host/HostName for aliases and the global git config's insteadOf, or refuse opaque remote-talking git and gh calls in block-other-jobs. GIT_DIR set as a shell variable is not followed either.
